name: Narukami Island
description: The area spans across Ritou, its port of entry, to Mt. Yougou which is home to the Grand Narukami Shrine, and on its coast is Inazuma City. It also has a mass of dense forests under the moonlight and underwater ruins alike. It is where the Inazuma Shogunate primarily takes rule, enforcing policies and laws in accordance to the Sakoku Decree. Inazuman public festivals and cultural events are being held here.
